title: ArduSubDiveLogs
description: Log alignment and correspondence metadata for ArduSub Dataflash (BIN) and telemetry (tlog, MCAP) logs in a directory.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this alignment schema.

directory.description: Target directory containing the dive log files.

created_iso.description: Timestamp when this alignment was generated (ISO 8601 UTC).

boots.description: Autopilot boot cycles (power cycles where TimeUS starts at 0).

boot_id.description: Unique 1-based index identifying the autopilot boot cycle in chronological order.

rtc_shift_s.description: Offset in seconds to add to autopilot uptime (TimeUS/1e6) to produce UTC epoch time. Null if unaligned.

start_iso.description: Estimated or verified autopilot boot time (ISO 8601 UTC).

end_iso.description: Estimated or verified autopilot shutdown / log end time (ISO 8601 UTC).

duration_s.description: Total elapsed power cycle duration in seconds.

alignment_method.description: Primary method used to establish rtc_shift_s.

signal_optimized.description: True if rtc_shift_s was refined using the depth trace signal optimizer (opt_rtc_shift).

depth_correlation_r.description: Pearson correlation coefficient r between BIN and MCAP depth tracks on the shared uptime axis (null if unverified).

bin_files.description: Basenames of BIN files belonging to this boot cycle.

mcap_files.description: Basenames of MCAP files belonging to this boot cycle.

bin_files.description: ArduSub Dataflash (.BIN) logs found in the directory.

boot_id.description: Identifier of the parent boot cycle, or null if unassociated.

log_disarmed.description: Value of LOG_DISARMED parameter (0 = log only while armed, 1 = log always).

uptime_start_s.description: First logged message timestamp in autopilot uptime seconds (TimeUS/1e6).

uptime_end_s.description: Last logged message timestamp in autopilot uptime seconds (TimeUS/1e6).

duration_s.description: Duration spanned by logged messages in seconds.

start_iso.description: Wall-clock start time in ISO 8601 UTC (uptime_start_s + rtc_shift_s).

end_iso.description: Wall-clock end time in ISO 8601 UTC (uptime_end_s + rtc_shift_s).

has_rtc_message.description: True if the BIN file contains ArduPilot RTC log messages with a valid epoch.

has_gps_fix.description: True if the BIN file contains GPS messages with a valid week and timestamp.

mcap_files.description: Basenames of MCAP files that temporally overlap this BIN file.
BlueOS MAVLink recordings (.mcap) found in the directory.

boot_id.description: Identifier of the parent boot cycle, or null if unassociated.

start_iso.description: First message log_time in ISO 8601 UTC.

end_iso.description: Last message log_time in ISO 8601 UTC.

uptime_start_s.description: First observed ArduSub time_boot_ms in seconds (time_boot_ms / 1000).

uptime_end_s.description: Last observed ArduSub time_boot_ms in seconds (time_boot_ms / 1000).

sample_rtc_shift_s.description: 1st percentile estimate of rtc_shift_s measured within this MCAP file.

flight_modes.description: Unique ArduSub flight modes recorded in this MCAP (in order of appearance).

bin_files.description: Basenames of BIN files that temporally overlap this MCAP file.
